title: AI Browser Game Jam #2 deadline extended to 4/29
author: Slackluster
selftext:
We extended the deadline to Wednesday April 29th to give people an extra weekend. If you've been thinking about joining, now is a good time.

The jam is simple: make a free browser game using AI. Any tools, any skill level. Theme is Alien but it's a suggestion, not a requirement. We already have 20 games submitted and 88 people joined.

This jam is completely open, no specific tools required, no sponsor telling you what to use. Use whatever AI you want for code, art, music, all of it.

You'd be surprised how much you can put together with AI in a few days. Some of the entries from the first jam were built in a weekend.

[https://itch.io/jam/ai-game-jam-2](https://itch.io/jam/ai-game-jam-2)

comments.author: Radiant_Mind33
comments.body:
Just hit publish on **Sludge Corp: Origins**!

It's a dark, cosmic-horror incremental game that starts with you growing wriggly hairs in a petri dish and escalates into a full-scale military siege, high-stakes genetic gambling, and ultimately... a hostile corporate takeover of Earth.

Mechanically, it features a standard clicker/idle economy, a mutation skill tree, a passive auto-battler to break out of the facility, and an end-game gacha system to sink your excess biomass into. (Built in React, and coded in collaboration with AI for the jam).

It's completely free and playable in the browser here: [Sludge Corp: Origins by VibeAxis Games](https://vibeaxis.itch.io/sludge-corp-origins)

We're really happy with how the pacing turned out, especially the transition from the mid-game wall into the final corporate market phase. Let us know if you manage to acquire the planet!
